## Take the root, then apply the power {#evaluate}

To evaluate without a calculator, take the root first. Raise that result to the numerator’s power.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$32^{\frac25}$

::: {.fragment}

[The denominator 5 tells you to take the fifth root.]{.annotation}

$=(\sqrt[5]{32})^2$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[The fifth root is 2. Square it.]{.annotation}

$=2^2=4$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$32^{\frac35}$

Which step changes when the numerator goes from 2 to 3? Predict, then evaluate on paper.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=(\sqrt[5]{32})^3$

$=2^3=8$

:::
